description: Search for Zendesk automations by their title. Use when you need to find automations in your Zendesk account by searching for keywords in their titles. Automations are business rules that automatically perform actions when certain conditions are met. This action supports filtering by active status and sorting results.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for searching Zendesk automations.

active.description: Filter automations by active status. Set to true to return only active automations, or false to return only inactive automations. When not specified, returns both active and inactive automations.
active.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to show only active automations, only inactive ones, or both. Useful for finding automations that are currently enabled or disabled.
active.title: Active

include.description: Sideload related data to include in the response. Currently supported: 'usage_24h' returns statistics about how many times each automation was triggered in the last 24 hours.
include.human_parameter_description: Add extra information to the results, such as how many times each automation was triggered in the last 24 hours.
include.title: Include

query.description: Query string used to find all automations with matching title. Case-insensitive partial match on automation titles.
query.human_parameter_description: Enter keywords to search for automations by their title. The search matches partial titles case-insensitively.
query.title: Query

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Options: 'alphabetical' (sorts A-Z), 'created_at' (by creation date), 'updated_at' (by last modification), 'position' (by dashboard position). If unspecified, automations are sorted by relevance to the query.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Choose how to order the search results: alphabetically by title, by when they were created, by when they were last updated, or by their position on the automations dashboard.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort order direction. Options: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'asc' for alphabetical and position sorts, 'desc' for created_at and updated_at sorts.
sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose whether results appear in ascending order (A-Z, oldest first) or descending order (Z-A, newest first).
sort_order.title: Sort Order
